about: Which circuit's verifying key each Verifier slot holds. Erc20CoinVault and EnygmaDvp name circuits by slot number (VK_ID_*), and the Verifier numbers keys in registration order, so scripts/cmd/init refuses keys that differ from this list and reads every slot back after registering.

nPublic is the key's number of public inputs. vkHash is keccak256(abi.encode(vk)) of the key as an IEnygmaDvp.VerifyingKey: the keys in gnark_circuits/scripts/keys are checked in, so a new key (make retail-keygen) changes it here too.
